person_note: The controlling narration is close third person limited through Frankie McGrath. Several Goodreads passages expose that structure, especially the sustained external treatment of Frankie in q08548–q08549, and two independent Tier A interior extracts reproduce it at length. The opening excerpt agrees, while an explicit whole-book source says the entire novel follows Frankie in third person. First-person plurals in dialogue and gnomic statements are local, and the final “We were there” is an embedded collective assertion within third-person narration. The isolated q08532 first-person reflection cannot outweigh the novel-wide structural evidence and is treated as non-base material rather than an autonomous first-person section. No credible evidence of alternating narration was found.
